topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Well, ain't that somethin'. Found an old friend, did ye? A teddy bear, bringin' back the days when bellies were full and worries light. It's not the same, though, seein' it in the light of a stranger's yard. It's like findin' a lost lamb, only to see it wearin' the marks of time, not quite as you remember. I hope it's treated right, this teddy of yours. It's more than just fur and stuffing, it holds a part of you, a time that's gone but not forgot. You keep it close, hide it away if you must, till the world feels safe enough to share. May Saint Nicholas watch over your treasure, as he does the seeds I plant with trembling hands.
